raw_response: {"diagnosis": "On 2026-01-16 the card feed renamed status POSTED to SETTLED with unchanged meaning, but silver_transactions still filters on status = 'POSTED', so batches 12-14 (all SETTLED or REVERSED, no POSTED) are dropped. The counts are consistent with this: all 978 SETTLED rows fall in batches 12-14, and the 236 REVERSED rows are spread across batches, so excluding REVERSED remains correct.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
